label: Default region to use when searching:
incipit-api URL to enable multi-source matching (Hardcover, OpenLibrary, duration) e.g. http://10.0.1.99:3737 — leave blank for standard Audible matching
Your Hardcover API token (get your own free token at hardcover.app/settings; leave blank to skip Hardcover)
Match authors tagged with a trailing series, e.g. "Author (Series)" -> "Author"
Recover the real author from the library folder when the artist tag matches no author (e.g. a narrator mis-tagged as the artist). Only runs when the tag itself finds nothing.

Recover the book title from the library folder when the album tag is missing or "[Unknown Album]" (strips a "YYYY - " prefix and a trailing "[Series]"). Only runs when there is no usable album tag, so it can never override a real title.
Simplify book titles (remove subtitle, series part, (un)abridged, etc.)

Prefer local or embedded cover art (use a cover.jpg/folder.jpg in the book folder, or the artwork embedded in the audio file, as the default poster when present; the matched cover stays as a fallback). Requires Local Media Assets enabled for the library.
Development: don't cache incipit-api responses (fetch fresh on every refresh so API changes appear immediately; slower, leave off for normal use)
